page.layout: One printed page with a running head at the top and the page number at the top right. Below the running head is a single full-page engraving, rotated on the scan, showing musicians with trumpets, a drum, a pipe and a wind instrument. No running text, no marginal notes and no caption on this page. At the far left edge is the edge of the facing page, which is not transcribed.
page.notes: Engraving, not transcribed: a rotated woodcut or engraving filling the page, showing musicians (trumpeters with long straight trumpets and banners, a drummer with a drum, a pipe player and a figure with a bagpipe-like instrument) on horseback or on foot, in front of a fortified building. The scan is rotated 90 degrees. Faint marks at the lower left of the printed area are too indistinct to read and are not transcribed. Text at the far left edge belongs to the facing page and is excluded.
